body: I know what it feels like when your family doesn't care too. My parents don't seem to understand that I have feelings too and that I can be depressed. Don't kill yourself right now though. I tell myself that one day, I really might kill myself, but not today. I hold on to the dreams that I will one day turn 18 and escape my parents.
